strategies.name: Naive 8-stage all-reduce loop
strategies.desc: Direct transcription of the reference: 8 iterations, each with one all_reduce dispatch plus local bidiagonal coupling and inverse coupling operations. 8 all_reduce dispatches total, O(W*S) payload each. Straightforward but maximal dispatch count; represents the baseline with no optimization.

strategies.name: Fused local-op batched all-reduce
strategies.desc: Merge all 8 stages' local computations (coupling/uncoupling) into vectorized operations where possible, but keep 8 separate all_reduce calls. Still 8 dispatches but reduces kernel launch overhead for local ops by fusing loops. Trades code complexity for marginal local-compute speedup without changing communication pattern.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter + all-gather factorization
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (producing W fragments of size W*S/W) followed by all_gather to reconstruct full vector. 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but each moves ~1/W of the all_reduce payload on the critical path, potentially better bandwidth utilization on hierarchical network topologies with 224 ranks.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapping with chunking
strategies.desc: Split the W*S vector into C chunks and issue all_reduce on chunk i while computing bidiagonal coupling for chunk i-1. Requires C+7 dispatches (C all_reduces in first stage, 7 more stages). Hides local computation latency behind communication when C is chosen to balance compute/comm, but increases dispatch count and complicates dependency tracking.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction tree
strategies.desc:
Exploit multi-node topology (224 ranks likely span multiple nodes): perform intra-node all_reduce (assuming ~28 ranks/node on 8 nodes) then inter-node all_reduce on representative ranks, then broadcast back. Each of 8 stages becomes 3 dispatches (intra + inter + bcast), totaling 24 dispatches, but reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure by 28x on the inter-node links.
